------------------

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, build and maintain test automation for embedded products. You will write Python frameworks and C test code that run against real hardware, simulators and production firmware. You will work closely with firmware, hardware and system teams to catch defects early and make every release faster and safer.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You will own the automation architecture, lead technical decisions and mentor other engineers, and you should be comfortable debugging at the boundary between software and hardware.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the architecture and long-term roadmap of the test automation framework and infrastructure for embedded products.
* Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks in Python, setting coding standards and best practices for the team.
* Write and maintain test code, test hooks and tools in C for firmware running on microcontrollers and DSPs.
* Lead the design of hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level test setups, including control of lab equipment (power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, DAQs).
* Automate testing over communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus and Ethernet.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins) and keep them fast and reliable.
* Define test strategy, test plans and coverage together with firmware, hardware and system engineers.
* Lead root-cause investigations of complex failures across firmware, hardware and system level.
* Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews.
* Evaluate new tools and technologies and drive improvements in test efficiency, stability and coverage.

----------------

* B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in Python, including designing test frameworks or automation tools from scratch (e.g. pytest).
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in C.
* Proven experience leading test automation for software that runs on hardware, from architecture to deployment.
* Strong background in software design, object-oriented design and clean, maintainable code.
* Deep understanding of software testing methods: unit, integration, system and regression testing.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools, including setting up and maintaining pipelines.
* Comfortable working in Linux environments and with scripting.
* Ability to read schematics and datasheets and use lab equipment for debugging.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work in a team.
* Good English, written and spoken.

--------------

* Experience with embedded systems, preferably from power electronics, automotive, robotics or similar industries.

* Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal firmware.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, Modbus, SPI, I2C, UART and Ethernet.
* Background in power electronics: inverters, converters, motor drives or battery systems.
* Experience with automotive or safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ASPICE) or functional safety testing.
* Experience automating lab instruments with SCPI, VISA or PyVISA.
* Experience with C++, Docker or cloud-based test infrastructure.

-----------------

* Work on products used at large scale in the field.
* A hands-on role with access to real hardware and well-equipped labs.
* Collaboration with experienced firmware, hardware and system engineers.
* Room to shape the automation strategy and tools.
